items.stem: During the PLC scan cycle, the controller:

options.text: Reads inputs, executes the program, then updates outputs, repeatedly
options.rationale: Correct: the scan reads inputs, solves logic, then writes outputs each cycle.

options.text: Updates outputs continuously in real time
options.rationale: Outputs update once per scan, not continuously.
Rungs execute in order within a scan.

options.text: Only runs the program once at power-up
options.rationale: The program runs every scan while in RUN mode.

items.explanation: Correct: the scan reads inputs, solves logic, then writes outputs each cycle.

items.stem: Which TWO statements about PLC timers and latches are correct? (Select TWO.)

options.text: An on-delay timer's output turns on after its preset time elapses
options.rationale: Correct: the TON output energises once the accumulated time reaches the preset.

options.text: A retentive (latched) element holds its state until explicitly reset
options.rationale: Correct: latches retain state until a reset condition acts.

options.text: A counter decreases every scan automatically
options.rationale: A counter changes only on its count event, not every scan.

options.text: A non-retentive timer keeps its value through a power loss
options.rationale: Non-retentive timers reset on power loss.

items.explanation: Correct: the TON output energises once the accumulated time reaches the preset.

items.stem: A rated safety function (e.g. an emergency stop) should be implemented using:

options.text: A dedicated safety-rated system or relay, not standard control logic
options.rationale: Correct: safety functions require rated devices to meet safety integrity requirements.

options.text: A normal coil in the main ladder program
options.rationale: Standard logic does not meet safety integrity requirements.
An HMI is not a rated safety stop.

options.text: A software comment reminding operators to be careful
options.rationale: A comment provides no protective function.

items.explanation: Correct: safety functions require rated devices to meet safety integrity requirements.
